title: Allow Fauxter to introduce himself

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Hey there! I mean, hi. Sorry, are you busy or...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey there! I mean, hi. Sorry, are you busy or...?

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I just wanted to ask a question. If that's not too much trouble?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just wanted to ask a question. If that's not too much trouble?

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I don't want anything to eat. I wanted to talk about my band.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want anything to eat. I wanted to talk about my band.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Well, we don't have a name yet. I mean we have an old name. "The Salty Dogs". We sang sailor songs, but not anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, we don't have a name yet. I mean we have an old name. "The Salty Dogs". We sang sailor songs, but not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I just thought you looked like you might enjoy our music. Maybe you have some ideas for a band name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just thought you looked like you might enjoy our music. Maybe you have some ideas for a band name?

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: I just need ideas. I might not use yours, but I can't think of anything good, so just shout something out. We play screamadelic funky glam bops. And there is five of us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just need ideas. I might not use yours, but I can't think of anything good, so just shout something out. We play screamadelic funky glam bops. And there is five of us.

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: That's... amazing! I'm gonna write that down. Thanks!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... amazing! I'm gonna write that down. Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Fauxter Glambeat
nodes.text: Then we were "The Malfunctioning Droids". But none of us were androids so it seemed a bit inappropriate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then we were "The Malfunctioning Droids". But none of us were androids so it seemed a bit inappropriate.
I am busy.
Not really.
Are you looking for noodles?
What are they called?
I don't really have time.
Interesting...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what did you need again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what did you need again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what did you need again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what did you need again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of music?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You thought I could name your band?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You thought I could name your band?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You thought I could name your band?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You thought I could name your band?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fauxter and the Glam Five?
The Funky Beards?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Dr. Coccolithophore and the Phantasmagorical Cavalcade of Funk?
